start_ray_cluster: initialize a Ray cluster with an optional Hydra DictConfig for configuration
launch_job_on_ray: launch a Hydra sweep task function as a remote Ray job with resource constraints
run_job_on_ray: run a Hydra job inside a Ray actor with singleton state and sweep config
create_ray_tmp_dir: create and clean up a temporary directory on a remote Ray cluster node
rsync_to_ray_cluster: rsync files to or from a Ray cluster head node using SSH key authentication
